sentences.text: `` Sweet Home Alabama '' is a song by Southern rock band Lynyrd Skynyrd that first appeared in 1974 on their second album , Second Helping .	Lynyrd Skynyrd	Lynyrd Skynyrd	Second Helping	Second Helping	Southern rock	Southern rock	Alabama	Harvest (Neil Young album)
It reached number 8 on the US chart in 1974 and was the band 's second hit single .

The song was written in reply to `` Southern Man '' and `` Alabama '' by Neil Young ; Young is name-checked in the song 's lyrics .	Southern Man	Southern Man	Alabama	Harvest (Neil Young album)	Neil Young	Neil Young

causal_questions.question: Sweet Home Alabama is a song that was written in reply to Neil Young's song Alabama.
